transcriber_notes: Printed date 2015-01-12 (year) disagrees with the file name/record_id (2014-01-12); the printed date is used (the file sits in the 2014-2015 season folder, consistent with 2015). Measured on the embedded 6160x2832 chart raster: no hatched surface row, so the plot top (y=139.5) is 130 cm; 20.09 px/cm; boundaries printed on the right axis (130/127/118/95/86/85/63/42/27/25/0) confirmed by bar edges. Hardness grid I/K/P/1F/4F/F at x=708/968/1228/1488/1748/2008 (260 px/class): F+ (127-118), 4F+ (118-95), 1F+ (95-86, 42-27) at one third past the class line; others on class lines. Temperature: red polyline without markers, break points 130/120/110/100/90/80/50/40/0 cm, converted with the Avanet raster fit x = 2115.5 + 46.80*T; no dashed air-temperature segment is drawn (no surface row) so no cross-check; +-0.2 C.
